units.source_text: 男人歪着头，重新点上一支香烟，他怎么也想不通。

en.t: The man tilted his head, lit another cigarette, and still could not make sense of it.

units.source_text: 站起来，他想悄悄地去看一下帘子那边的屋子。

en.t: He stood up, wanting to slip over quietly and look at the room beyond the curtain.

units.source_text: 那里确实有一间屋子，但没有地板。

en.t: There was indeed a room there, but it had no floor.

units.source_text: 代替地板的是沙子，它们描绘出柔软的曲线，

en.t: In place of a floor there was sand, tracing soft curves,

units.source_text: 像是从对面墙壁缝里落下来的。

en.t: as if it had fallen from cracks in the wall opposite.

units.source_text: 他禁不住毛骨悚然，呆呆站立，愣着动弹不了。

en.t: He could not help shuddering; he stood there blankly, stunned and unable to move.

units.source_text: ……原来这屋子的一半已经死了……

en.t: ... So half of this house was already dead ...

units.source_text: 已经被不停流动的沙子的触手，掏空了一半内脏……

en.t: Its innards had already been half hollowed out by the tentacles of endlessly flowing sand ...

units.source_text: 除了平均1/8m.m.以外，连自身形状都不具备的沙子……

en.t: Sand that, apart from an average of 1/8 m.m., did not even possess a shape of its own ...

units.source_text: 还没有任何东西敢于面对这个无形的破坏力……

en.t: Nothing yet had dared to face this formless destructive power ...

units.source_text: 或许不具备任何形态，才是力的最高表现吧……

en.t: Perhaps having no form at all was the highest expression of power ...
